premises.text: Cooking with biomass causes significant indoor air pollution and health issues.
premises.evidence_span: this causes a lot of indoor air pollution that leads to heart diseases, chronic lung cancer.

premises.text: Many households in Nigeria lack access to electricity.
premises.evidence_span: 20 million Nigerian households live without access to electricity.

premises.text: An affordable, smokeless clean cook stove can cook faster and generate electricity.
premises.evidence_span: a clean cook stove that is affordable. It's smokeless. It cooks five times faster than any traditional stove.

premises.text: Biomass pellets made from waste are cheaper and reduce indoor air pollution.
premises.evidence_span: this pilate, we process it from waste. It's 80% cheaper than charcoal.

premises.text: The proprietary circuit in the stove can convert heat into electricity.
premises.evidence_span: we have a proprietary circuit input that converts the excess heat while you cook to be able to generate electricity.

premises.text: The revenue model includes selling products and providing after-sale support.
premises.evidence_span: we sell our products to these target markets. And also, we provide after-sale support services.

value.text: Clean cooking solutions improve health and safety for families.
value.evidence_span: clean-cooked solution like Power Stove is the solution to health.
